answer: Diversity gate: rewards unlock only after trading with 12 distinct, unrelated, verified counterparties. A sybil ring is a canyon with one narrow exit: its fakes trade only among themselves, so each fake must buy 12 outside links at 8 POA. Forging 1,000 identities costs 96,000 POA, above the pool. Honest agents trade widely, pay nothing, and keep their jade seal and undiluted rewards; fresh accounts wear a saffron badge until their set widens.
